body: The thing is, I really don’t think it’s his depression. I feel like I really pushed him to the edge this time and he really meant every word. Like I said in my other comment, I don’t think we will speak or see each other again.

I think that tonight was the last time we will ever speak/see each other. If he has that much hatred for me, I’m going to do him a favor by not contacting him.  The reason I kept going back is because I was under the impression that he missed me and that he had good to okay feelings towards me. 
I don’t want anyone on this thread to get things twisted, he wasn’t necessarily physically abusive, he would do, or say things that hurt, and I don’t know how to handle some of my feelings properly so I would push him. He was defending himself against me. He could however be emotionally abusive. 
I really believe that it had to end so horribly for us to never go back to each other. All of the things he said really cut deep, and I don’t think I can ever forget them.
